newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA CONFIRM VAN GAAL APPOINTMENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA CONFIRM VAN GAAL APPOINTMENT.

text.p: Barcelona confirmed on Monday that Ajax Amsterdam boss Louis van Gaal would replace Bobby Robson as coach next season.
A Barcelona official said van Gaal would be officially presented on Monday at 4.30 pm local time (1430 gmt).
Van Gaal, 45, joined Ajax in 1988. He has led them to success in the Dutch championship, UEFA Cup, European Cup and European Super Cup and seen them crowned as world club champions.
Robson, the former England manager, is expected to remain at Barcelona as general manager.
